{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {sales['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue 999999.99: {(sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check channel distribution
print(f"Channel distribution:\n{sales['channel'].value_counts()}")

# Check customer_segment distribution
print(f"Customer segment distribution:\n{sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate order_id: {sales['order_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Summary of key findings
sales.info()"}
